prompt: Create a high-resolution square composition featuring exactly 23 human-like figures arranged with generous spacing in a calm, minimal environment. Each figure must appear clearly unique at first glance, with distinct variations in body shape, posture, proportions, and muted natural color tones, creating a strong perception of individuality across the entire group. Include exactly one pair of figures that are perfectly identical in every visual detail (same shape, color, and orientation). These two identical figures must be placed far apart within the composition so their duplication is not immediately noticeable. The scene should initially read as a collection of entirely different individuals, but gradually reveal an unexpected duplication, creating a subtle but unsettling realization. Do not include any text, numbers, symbols, charts, or infographic elements. Avoid flat icon or graphic design styles. Use soft, diffused lighting and a clean, minimal background with a gentle atmospheric gradient. Style: semi-realistic, contemporary generative art, slightly surreal, highly detailed with smooth shading and refined forms. Resolution: 2048x2048 or higher. The composition should strongly reinforce the expectation of uniqueness, then quietly violate it through a single rare duplication within a small group.
visual_logic: A small group of distinct figures appears entirely unique, yet a single identical pair exists unnoticed, revealing an unexpectedly high chance of matching within a limited set.
